about: Dated steps toward protection from heat in South and Southeast Asia, for the Atlas (/atlas/). Each comes from a source the site already cites. Kinds: plan, rule, role, programme. Places carry approximate coordinates for the drawn map. The monthly update may add milestones (record type milestone in data/schema/records.json) under the same checks. A milestone describes what was done, never a judgement of how well.

milestones.title: Odisha writes its first heat action plan
milestones.text: After the 1998 heatwave, Odisha wrote a heat action plan in 1999. The next year, recorded heat deaths fell to 91.
source: Down To Earth: how to fight heat wave the Odisha way

milestones.title: Ahmedabad launches South Asia’s first city heat action plan
milestones.text: Early warnings, prepared hospitals and public outreach. An evaluation later estimated about 1,190 deaths a year avoided.

milestones.title: Early action for heatwaves in 15 of Hanoi’s wards
milestones.text: From 2018 to 2021, the Viet Nam Red Cross ran an early-action plan triggered by a heat-index forecast.
source: Anticipation Hub: reducing heatwave impacts on vulnerable people in Hanoi

milestones.title: Mumbai’s climate action plan names urban heat a priority
milestones.text: The 2022 plan names urban heat as a priority; the city is working on heat-health protocols for its hospitals.
source: Citizen Matters: Mumbai Climate Action Plan and heat

milestones.title: Dhaka North appoints Asia’s first Chief Heat Officer
milestones.text: A named person in city government to coordinate action on heat.
source: Arsht-Rock: Dhaka North’s Chief Heat Officer, 2023

milestones.title: Singapore’s Heat Stress Advisory
milestones.text: Heat stress rated low, moderate or high from the wet-bulb globe temperature, with what to do at each level, including shaded rest for heavy outdoor work.
source: Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment, 2023

milestones.title: Nepalgunj writes Nepal’s first local heat action plan
milestones.text: A city in the plains, where heat is most intense, plans ahead of the hot season.
source: Onlinekhabar: reassessing Nepal’s heat wave response

milestones.title: Nepal adopts a national plan of action on heat waves
milestones.text: A national plan follows the first local one.
source: Onlinekhabar: reassessing Nepal’s heat wave response

milestones.title: Thane plans ward by ward
milestones.text: A heat action plan that maps risk and actions down to each ward of the city.
source: CEEW: how can Thane city tackle heatwave risks

milestones.title: Tamil Nadu builds a state-wide heat network
milestones.text: A state strategy that names the groups heat plans are meant to reach, from outdoor workers to prisoners.
source: Tamil Nadu State Planning Commission, 2024: Beating the Heat

milestones.title: Central government hospitals asked to set up heatwave units
milestones.text: During the 2024 heatwave, central government hospitals were told to set up dedicated units for heat illness.

milestones.title: Delhi launches its 2025 Heat Action Plan
milestones.text: Graded heat alerts, cooling shelters, 3,000 water points and heatstroke units in hospitals.

milestones.title: Bangkok opens 304 cooling centres
milestones.text: Schools, health centres and district offices open as cooling centres for the hot season, under a city heat management plan.
source: Thailand government: Bangkok launches 304 cooling centres
